about.title: Who is behind QMap
about.p1: {company} develops QMap, a digital map of residential complexes. We launched in Varshavskyi, added Dibrova and are ready to connect new complexes. We help residents quickly find services near home and help local businesses get noticed by their neighbours.
about.p2: Our goal is simple: information about life in every complex should be accurate, gathered in one place and available to all residents.

blocks.text: **Translation.** This is an English translation for convenience. If it differs from the Ukrainian version, the Ukrainian version prevails.

This Policy explains what personal data the **{app}** mobile app (the “App”) and the website {domain} (together, the “Service”) process, why, who receives the data and what rights you have. It is prepared under the Law of Ukraine “On Personal Data Protection” and serves as the notice to the data subject under Article 12 of that Law.
**In short.** We process only the data the map needs to work. We do not sell personal data, show personalised ads or track you across other apps or websites.
1. Owner of personal data
Owner of personal data: {company}, {companyId}, registered address: {address}. Email for personal data questions: {email}.
2. What data we process
2.1. Data you provide

items: **Account data:** name, email address and/or phone number, the residential complex you chose. If you sign in with Apple or Google, we receive the identifier and email that service shares. Passwords are stored only as hashes.

**Business data:** business name, category, location in the complex (building, section, entrance), opening hours, contact phone, website or social media links, photos. If a sole proprietor runs the business, this data may include their name and phone. Business data is published on the map and visible to all users.
**Messages:** content reports, map error reports, support emails.

blocks.text: 2.2. Data collected automatically

items: **Location** (precise or approximate), only with your permission in the phone settings. It is used on the device to show where you are and build routes. We do not send coordinates to our servers or keep a location history.
**Technical data:** device model, operating system and App version, language, push notification identifier.
**Diagnostics:** crash and error reports with an installation identifier.

**Usage data:** screen views and actions in the App, such as opening a business card, building a route or tapping “Call”. Business owners see aggregated statistics for their card (views, routes, calls) with no data about individual users.

blocks.text: 2.3. What we do not process
Phone contacts, photos you did not choose, payment data, health data, biometric data, advertising identifiers (IDFA/AAID).
3. Purposes and legal grounds
The legal grounds are set out in Article 11 of the Law of Ukraine “On Personal Data Protection”.

head: Purpose
Data
Legal ground
rows: Conclusion and performance of a transaction (the Terms of Use)
Publishing and updating a business on the map
Consent of the business owner or representative, given in the “Add business” form
Push notifications about new places and changes
Statistics for business owners, improving the App
Protection of the owner’s legitimate interests
Protection of the owner’s legitimate interests
Protection of the owner’s legitimate interests

Performance of the owner’s legal obligation

blocks.text: 4. Processors and other recipients
We do not sell personal data or share it for advertising. Data may be received by:

items.text: **Personal data processors** that process data on our behalf and only for the purposes of this Policy:
items: Google LLC (USA): Firebase and Google Cloud for data storage, authentication including SMS sign-in by phone number, push notifications (Firebase Cloud Messaging), crash reports (Crashlytics) and usage analytics;
Apple Inc. (USA): push notifications on iPhone (Apple Push Notification service), Sign in with Apple;
Vercel Inc. (USA): hosting of the website {domain};
{mapProvider}: map display.
**Other users**: only public business data (name, location in the complex, hours, contacts, photos).
**Public authorities**: in the cases and manner provided by law.
**A legal successor**: if the Service is reorganised or sold, with prior notice to users.

blocks.text: 5. Transfers outside Ukraine

The Service’s main database is hosted on servers in {dbRegion}. Some data (crash reports, push tokens, website technical logs) may be processed on servers in the USA. Such transfers comply with Article 29 of the Law of Ukraine “On Personal Data Protection”: they are needed to perform the Terms of Use concluded in your interest and are made with the consent you give when you register. We only work with providers that are contractually bound to protect the data.
6. Retention

items: Account data: while the account is active, and no more than 30 days after it is deleted.
Business data: while the card is published or until a deletion request.
Messages and reports: up to 12 months after they are handled.
Diagnostics and technical logs: up to 90 days.
Data with a retention period set by law: for that period.

blocks.text: 7. Your rights
Under Article 8 of the Law of Ukraine “On Personal Data Protection” you have the right to:

items: know what data about you we process, why, where it is stored and who receives it;
access your data;
be told whether your data is processed within 30 calendar days of your request;
require correction or destruction of inaccurate or unlawfully processed data;
object to the processing of your data;
withdraw consent at any time (for example, by turning off location or notifications in the phone settings, or by deleting your account);
protect your data against unlawful processing and claim compensation for damage;
complain to the Ukrainian Parliament Commissioner for Human Rights ([ombudsman.gov.ua](https://ombudsman.gov.ua)) or go to court.

blocks.text: To use these rights, write to {email} from the email or phone linked to your account. We reply within 30 calendar days.
8. Deleting your account
You can delete your account in the App (Profile → Settings → Delete account) or by email without signing in. See [Delete Account and Data](/delete-account).
9. Children
The Service is not intended for people under 16. We do not knowingly process their data. If you think a child has given us their data, write to {email} and we will delete it.
10. Security

We encrypt data in transit (TLS), store passwords only as hashes, limit access to data to the people who need it for their work, and review our safeguards regularly. If a data breach may affect your rights, we will tell you without undue delay.
11. Summary for the App Store and Google Play

head: Data type
Processed
Linked to you
Tracking
rows: On the device only, not sent to servers

blocks.text: All data is encrypted in transit. You can ask us to delete your data.
12. Changes to this Policy

We may update this Policy. We will announce material changes in the App and by email at least 14 days before they take effect. If changes affect processing based on consent, we will ask for your consent again.

These Terms are an agreement between you and {company}, {companyId} (“we”) on the use of the **{app}** app and the website {domain} (together, the “Service”). They are an electronic contract under the Law of Ukraine “On Electronic Commerce”.

**How the agreement is made.** The agreement is concluded when you tick “I agree to the Terms of Use and the Privacy Policy” during registration. If you use the Service without an account, you accept these Terms by using it. If you do not agree, do not use the Service.
1. The Service

{app} is an interactive map of the residential complexes connected to the Service. Residents find businesses and services in their complex, and business owners publish and update information about their places.
2. Price

The Service is currently free for residents and businesses. We may introduce paid features for businesses in the future. They will be optional, and we will publish their terms before launch. Existing free features will not become paid without your consent.
3. Account

items: You can view the map without an account. An account is needed to add or edit a business, save favourite places, and send reports.
You must be at least 16 to create an account.
You provide accurate data and are responsible for keeping access to your account secure.
You can delete your account at any time in the App or by following [these instructions](/delete-account).

blocks.text: 4. Listing a business

items: Only the owner or an authorised representative of a business that actually operates in a complex connected to the Service may add it.

You confirm that the business information (name, location in the complex, hours, contacts, photos) is true and does not infringe third-party rights, and that the business operates lawfully, including holding any required licences.

Every submission and change is moderated. We may ask for documents confirming your authority or licence, and may reject, edit or unpublish a card that breaks these Terms or the [Content Rules](/content-rules).
You agree to update the information if the hours change or the business moves or closes.

blocks.text: 5. Business offers

Businesses may publish offers and discounts for residents. The business that publishes an offer sets and fulfils its terms. We are not a party to your dealings with a business and are not responsible for offers or for the quality of a business’s goods and services.
6. Your content

You keep the rights to the content you upload (text, photos). By publishing it, you give us a free, non-exclusive, worldwide licence to use, reproduce and display it within the Service for as long as it is published. The licence ends when the content is deleted, unless the law requires us to keep it.
7. Not allowed

items: posting false, offensive or unlawful information, or spam;
impersonating other people or businesses;
interfering with the Service, bypassing its protection, or scraping data;
using the Service in breach of Ukrainian law.

blocks.text: Details are in the [Content Rules](/content-rules).
8. Information on the map

We check data before publishing it, but business owners provide the information about their businesses. We do not guarantee it is fully accurate. If you spot a mistake, tap “Report a mistake” on the business card or write to {email}.
9. Intellectual property

The App, its design, the complex maps, the logo and the {app} name belong to us or our licensors. We give you a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable licence to use the App for its intended purpose, including listing and managing business cards.
10. Liability

The Service is provided “as is”. To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect losses or loss of data or profit related to using the Service. This does not limit your rights under Ukrainian law, including the Law of Ukraine “On Consumer Rights Protection”.
11. Suspension and termination
We may restrict or end access to an account that breaks these Terms and will tell you why, unless the law forbids it. You may end the agreement at any time by deleting your account.
12. App store terms

If you downloaded the App from the App Store, these Terms are between you and us, not Apple Inc. Apple is not responsible for the App or its support. Apple’s standard Licensed Application End User License Agreement (EULA) also applies. Apple and its subsidiaries are third-party beneficiaries of these Terms. If you downloaded the App from Google Play, the Google Play Terms of Service also apply.
13. Governing law and disputes
These Terms are governed by the law of Ukraine. Disputes are settled by negotiation and, failing agreement, by a court under Ukrainian law. You can send a claim to {email}; we reply within 14 days.
14. Changes to these Terms

We may change these Terms. We will announce material changes in the App and by email at least 14 days before they take effect. If you do not agree, you can delete your account. Continuing to use the Service after the changes take effect means you accept them.

These rules apply to all content users add to **{app}**: business cards, photos, descriptions, offers, error reports and complaints. They are part of the [Terms of Use](/terms).
1. What you can publish

items: Real businesses and services operating lawfully in a complex connected to {app}.
The exact location in the complex, current hours and contacts.
Your own photos of the business’s front, entrance or interior.
Offers and discounts the business actually provides.

blocks.text: 2. What is not allowed

items: Fake or made-up businesses, wrong addresses, other people’s businesses without authority.
Offensive, discriminatory, violent or sexual content.
Hate speech, threats, harassment, sharing other people’s personal data.
Propaganda for the aggressor state, justifying or denying armed aggression against Ukraine, symbols banned by law.
Advertising goods and services that are banned or restricted in Ukraine, and activity without a required licence.
Fraud, misleading advertising, spam.
Content that infringes copyright or trademarks.

blocks.text: 3. Moderation

A moderator checks every new card and every change before publication, usually within 24 hours. For licensed activities (pharmacies, medical services and similar) the moderator may ask for the licence number. We also filter profanity automatically.
4. How to report content

items: Open the business card on the map.
Tap “⋯” → “Report” and choose a reason.
Add a comment if needed and send.

blocks.text: You can also write to {email}. We review reports within 24 hours, remove content that breaks the rules and block the author’s account if needed.
5. How to hide a user’s content
Open the business card → “⋯” → “Block author”. You will no longer see their content, and we will be notified to review it.
6. Consequences
Depending on how serious the breach is: rejection or removal of content, a warning, or a temporary or permanent account block. We may report content showing signs of a crime to law enforcement.
This page explains how to delete your **{app}** account and the data linked to it. Developer: {company}.
Option 1. In the app

items: Open {app} and sign in.
Go to “Profile” → “Settings”.
Tap “Delete account” and confirm.

blocks.text: The account is deactivated immediately, and the data is deleted within 30 days.
Option 2. Without signing in
Send an email from the address linked to your account, or include the phone number the account is registered to.
Address
Subject

We confirm receipt within 3 business days. To protect your account, we may ask you to confirm it is yours (for example, with a code sent to the linked email or phone). After confirmation, the data is deleted within 30 days.
What is deleted

items: Account data: name, email, phone number, password hash, Apple or Google sign-in identifiers.
Favourite places, notification settings, push token.
Business cards you created are unpublished and deleted, unless you handed them over to another representative of the business.
Your reports and error messages are anonymised: the content stays, the link to you does not.

blocks.text: What may be kept

items: Crash reports and technical logs: up to 90 days, not linked to your account.
Backups: up to 30 days, then overwritten.
Data with a retention period set by law: for that period.

blocks.text: Deleting some data without deleting the account
You can delete individual photos, a business card or favourite places in the app, or ask us by email at {email}.
We help with any **{app}** question, from signing in to listing a business on the map.
Contact us
We reply within 1 business day. Please include your phone model, the app version (Profile → About) and a short description of the problem.
How to add a business

items: Install {app}, choose your complex and create an account.
On the map, tap “+ Add business”.
Fill in the name, category, building, section, entrance and hours. Add a photo of the front.
Submit for moderation. Review usually takes up to 24 hours.

blocks.text: Common problems
I can’t see my location on the map
Check that the app has location access in your phone settings. Without it the map works, just without your marker.
Notifications don’t arrive
Turn on notifications for {app} in your phone settings and in Profile → Notifications.
There is a mistake on the map
Open the business card → “Report a mistake”. We will check and fix it. If the button is not available, write to {email}.
I want to delete my account
See [Delete Account and Data](/delete-account).
Connect your complex
A homeowners’ association, management company, developer or residents’ group can apply at {email}. Include the complex name and address and a contact person.

This page explains which cookies and similar technologies the **{app}** website uses and why.
**In short.** We only use necessary cookies to remember the site language. No ads, no analytics, no tracking.
1. What cookies are
Cookies are small text files that a website stores in your browser. They help the site work properly, for example by remembering your settings.
2. What we use

head: Name
Purpose
Type
Duration
rows: Remembers the site language (Ukrainian or English)
Remembers that you closed the cookie notice

blocks.text: 3. What we don’t use
We don’t use advertising, analytics or third-party tracking cookies, and we don’t share cookie data with third parties.
4. Do we need your consent

Necessary cookies are required for the site to work, so they don’t need separate consent. If we ever add analytics or other optional cookies, we will ask for your consent before using them and update this page.
5. How to manage cookies
You can delete or block cookies in your browser settings. The site will still work, but it may not remember your language.
6. Contacts
Send questions about cookies and personal data to {email}. How we process personal data is described in the [Privacy Policy](/privacy).
